name: Paycheck Planner: Budget
subtitle: Organise your money by payday
promotionalText: See exactly what each pay has to cover and what's left over after bills. Link regular bills to the right payday and tick them off as you pay.
description:
Paycheck Planner budgets the way you actually get paid: one pay at a time.

Add your income sources and bills, and every upcoming pay shows which bills it covers and how much is left once they're paid.

PLAN EVERY PAY
• See each upcoming pay with its bills and what's left over
• Browse month by month with a chart of what's left after bills
• Tick bills off as you pay them and track progress for each pay

FITS YOUR PAY CYCLE
• Weekly, fortnightly, twice a month (like the 15th and 30th), or monthly
• For twice-a-month pay, move weekend paydays to the Friday before
• Track more than one source of income

BILLS THAT LAND IN THE RIGHT PLACE
• Link a regular bill to an income source so it's added automatically
• Choose whether it comes out of every pay or just one pay a month
• Add one-off expenses to a specific pay, and move them if plans change
• Bill amount different this month? Change it for just that pay

PAY IN ONE TAP
• Save a payment link with each bill and open it straight from your pay
• Optionally mark a bill as paid when you tap its link

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
• No account, no sign-up, no bank connection
• Nothing is collected or shared; everything is stored on your device

Light and dark mode, plus an option to show amounts without cents.
